purpose: Reproducible triage-validation manifest: every case is one adjudicated vitest failure (id, evidence path, adjudicated label, note). Agreement = (classifier label == adjudicated label)/n, per class and overall.
adjudicationProtocol: Implementing worker labels each case from its evidence; lead double-reviews every label; disagreements resolved by joint re-read with the resolution recorded in the case's adjudication-note. Labels: port-caused | fixture-problem.
promotionRule: Promotion of the Jev classifier to DEFAULT requires >= 20 cases AND >= 5 per class AND >= 90% overall AND >= 80% in every class. ANY per-class shortfall (< 5 cases or < 80%) marks that class insufficient and the classifier stays NON-default.
